newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai steel firm to buy $150 mln coal from Canada.
newsitem.headline: Thai steel firm to buy $150 mln coal from Canada.

text.p: Thai Special Steel Industry Plc (TSSI) said on Friday it signed a memorandum of understanding to buy coal worth $150 million from Canada's Fording Coal Co Ltd.
A TSSI official said the agreement called for Fording Coal to supply 400,000 to 500,000 tonnes of coking coal to TSSI's blast furnace and coke oven complex for five years beginning 1998.
TSSI, a unit of Thai Petrochemical Industry Plc, is building Thailand's first integrated steel refinery in eastern Rayong province.

The plant will begin producing iron and steel products this year with annual output reaching 500,000 tonnes of wire rods, 3.4 million tonnes of pig iron, 2.3 million tonnes of liquid iron, and 2.2 million tonnes of billets by the second quarter of 1999.
